title: Extra 15% off at Snappi with Capitec Live Better
summary: Capitec Live Better clients can use CAPITEC15 for an extra 15% off already discounted items at Snappi.
terms: Capitec says the code is limited to one voucher per person per month, applies to one sitewide purchase excluding liquor, and has no minimum spend. A Snappi account is required.

title: 25% or 30% off ANEW Hotels stays for Capitec clients
summary: Use LIVEBETTER when checking availability at selected ANEW Hotels, then pay with a qualifying Capitec card.
terms: The official Capitec page states 25% off when paying with a Debit Card, or 30% off plus DragonPass access when spending at least R1,500 with a Credit Card. Selected hotels, a minimum two-night stay, direct booking, availability and other rate conditions apply.

title: 15% off selected South Africa tour departures
summary: G Adventures lists 15% off selected South Africa departures with promo code G26SDQ015SAF03.
terms: The official trip page shows the code for selected departures from 22 October to 29 November 2026. Prices, eligible dates and availability vary. Confirm the discount before paying.

title: 25% off Dress Your Tech accessories for Capitec clients
summary: Eligible Capitec Live Better clients receive 25% off through the Dress Your Tech offer in the Capitec app.
terms: No code or minimum spend is stated. Eligible clients must open the offer through Cash back, deals and more in the Capitec app; the discount is applied automatically to the dedicated collection at checkout.

title: Three months free Spotify Premium Standard for new listeners
summary: Capitec clients who are new Spotify listeners can claim three months of Spotify Premium Standard through the Capitec app.
terms: For new Spotify listeners using a Capitec Debit or Credit Card. Claim through the Capitec app. The voucher lasts three months from issue and the paid subscription starts automatically afterward unless cancelled. The official redemption deadline is 7 January 2028.

title: 15% instant discount on selected Dis-Chem brands
summary: Capitec clients can receive a 15% instant discount on more than 140 selected brands at Dis-Chem.
terms: Join Dis-Chem Better Rewards, link the card in the Capitec app, present the rewards card and pay with a Capitec Debit, Credit or Virtual Card. The fixed 15% discount applies only to qualifying brands and can stack with marked discounts.

title: Up to 30% back at Petshop Science with UCount
summary: Qualifying Standard Bank UCount members can earn up to 30% back in Rewards Points at Petshop Science stores.
terms: The earn rate depends on UCount tier and card type. The top rate applies to qualifying Virtual Credit Card purchases. In-store purchases only, with an R500 spend cap per fixed cycle. Standard Bank and UCount eligibility rules apply.

title: Up to 50% back on HealthyCare items
summary: Qualifying Discovery Vitality and Discovery Bank members can earn up to 50% back on HealthyCare products at Clicks or Dis-Chem.
terms: Activate HealthyCare and link the relevant Clicks ClubCard or Dis-Chem Better Rewards card. Vitality Health members can earn up to 25%; a qualifying Discovery Bank product and Vitality Money engagement can increase the total to 50%. Monthly spend thresholds, limits and qualifying-product rules apply.

title: R50 to R150 off at participating South African merchants
summary: UnionPay cardholders can receive an instant discount of R50, R100 or R150 when meeting the qualifying spend at participating merchants.
terms: Save R50 on R1,000, R100 on R1,500 or R150 on R2,000 in one transaction at a listed participating merchant. One discount per card per day at each merchant, maximum 20 campaign discounts per card, while quotas last. Tiers cannot be combined.

title: R100 off your first Mr Price app purchase of R500 or more
summary: Apply MRP100 to an eligible first app order of at least R500.
terms: The first-purchase discount is for the South African Mr Price app. A qualifying paid order is required and delivery or collection charges can affect the final total. Stock, payment and app conditions apply. The current official welcome page does not state a fixed closing date.

title: Current Mr Price multi-buy and marked-down promotions
summary: Mr Price lists current limited-time clothing promotions and multi-buy prices on selected lines.
terms: Promotions apply only to the selected products and variants shown on the official Mr Price promotions page. Online and in-store availability can differ, stock is limited and each displayed promotion may end without a shared campaign date.

title: Woolworths Daily Difference offers until 23 August
summary: Woolworths is listing current Daily Difference grocery savings for online and participating in-store shoppers.
terms: The official Daily Difference page states that the current offer period is 3 to 23 August 2026, while stocks last. Products and savings vary by region, and promotions displayed online may differ from those available in stores.

title: 99c bakery bread for qualifying FNB Easy customers
summary: FNB Easy PAYU and Easy Bundle customers can qualify for a 600g bakery loaf for 99c, up to four times a month.
terms: Available to qualifying FNB Easy PAYU or Easy Bundle customers paying with an FNB Easy Debit Card. The current FNB page and pricing guide describe a 600g white or brown bakery loaf for 99c, up to four times monthly, at participating Pick n Pay or Boxer stores. Qualification, voucher, stock and eBucks limits apply.

title: Monthly grocery and health coupons for 1LifeStyle members
summary: Eligible 1Life policyholders can access monthly grocery and health-and-beauty coupons through the 1Life app.
terms: The benefit is for eligible 1Life policyholders whose required premiums and DebiCheck mandate are up to date. Members select participating retailers in the app and claim available product coupons monthly. Retailer selection, benefit level, product, quantity and redemption limits apply.

title: 10% instant saving on selected Better Rewards brands
summary: Dis-Chem Better Rewards members receive a base 10% instant discount on qualifying products from selected brands.
terms: Better Rewards is free to join. The base 10% discount applies to qualifying products from the brands identified by Dis-Chem and may combine with specified boosts. Prescription medicine is not discounted. Product eligibility, monthly limits and the full Better Rewards rules apply.

title: Up to 25% off The Pro Shop vouchers with Multiply
summary: Eligible Momentum Multiply members can buy discounted vouchers for use at The Pro Shop, with the saving based on their rewards level.
terms: The official Multiply benefit lists savings from 5% to 25%, depending on programme and rewards level. Members buy a voucher through Multiply Mall and use it at The Pro Shop. A valid South African Visa or Mastercard, membership eligibility and The Pro Shop terms apply.

title: 20% off weekend stays at participating City Lodge hotels
summary: Select the WKND Special rate to receive 20% off the best available rate at participating Courtyard, City Lodge and Town Lodge properties.
terms: The official WKND Special applies at participating Courtyard Hotel, City Lodge Hotel and Town Lodge properties for eligible weekend stays. Select the named rate when booking. City Lodge Hotel at OR Tambo International Airport is excluded, and availability and hotel conditions apply.

title: Up to 20% off longer stays at &Beyond South Africa lodges
summary: Stay six or more nights across eligible &Beyond South Africa lodges and camps to receive a long-stay saving of up to 20%.
terms: The official offer lists up to 15% off stays of six or more nights and up to 20% off stays of eight or more nights at eligible South African lodges and camps. Savings use published 2026 or 2027 rates and depend on season, availability, guest itinerary and property terms.

title: Up to 29% off selected August South Africa tours
summary: Bookmundi is displaying reduced prices on selected South Africa tour departures scheduled for August 2026.
terms: Savings vary by tour, operator, traveller type and departure date. The official marketplace page showed discounts of up to 29% when checked. Confirm the current reduced price, itinerary, availability, currency, cancellation rules and final booking terms on the individual tour page before paying.

title: Online-only Steers app meal deals
summary: Steers lists app-only sharing meals, burger combinations and selected free-drink offers on its official online-deals page.
terms: Offers are available through the Steers app or online ordering route and can vary by participating restaurant. Prices, meal contents, substitutions, Halaal alternatives, stock and delivery availability must be confirmed in the app before ordering.

title: Frequently refreshed offers in the Burger King SA app
summary: The official Burger King South Africa app provides restaurant offers and generates the relevant redemption code in the app.
terms: Offer selection, price, validity and participating restaurant can vary. Choose an offer in the official South African app and present its generated code to the cashier as instructed. Review the in-app conditions before ordering; Freehub does not publish or guess the rotating app codes.

title: Cell C device and contract deals until 10 August
summary: Cell C's current Connector booklet lists selected phone, device and data contract promotions for the June-to-August deal cycle.
terms: Offers are valid through 10 August 2026 while stocks last. Device, contract term and Elevate plan eligibility vary. The official booklet states that standard RICA applies and that a once-off SIM and connection fee of R199 applies to contracts unless the individual deal says otherwise.

title: Current Hirsch's appliance and electronics promotions
summary: Hirsch's official promotions catalogue lists current marked-down appliances, electronics and household products.
terms: Savings apply only to products marked as promotions on the official Hirsch's catalogue. Price, stock, delivery, model, region and promotion end date can differ by item. Confirm the current price and product-specific terms before paying.

title: Free OMO bundle with selected Samsung washing machines
summary: Buy a qualifying Samsung washing machine and redeem an OMO washing-liquid and capsule bundle, while promotional stock lasts.
terms: Samsung Electronics South Africa runs this promotion. South African residents aged 18 or older must buy one of the Samsung washing-machine models listed in the official Makro terms from a participating retailer by 30 August 2026 and keep valid proof of purchase. Redeem during the same period by scanning the in-store QR code or sending SAMSUNG to +27 87 265 2228 on WhatsApp, then upload the invoice or till slip. After verification, Samsung sends an SMS coupon for the matching bundle: 4L, 10L or 16L of OMO Auto Washing Liquid plus 20 OMO Auto Capsules. The offer is first come, first served while promotional stock lasts; data charges may apply, and Samsung may reclaim the offer value if the qualifying appliance is returned or exchanged after redemption.

title: R800 Checkers voucher with four Dunlop Grandtrek tyres
summary: Buy four qualifying Dunlop Grandtrek tyres and register for Dunlop Sure tyre insurance to receive an R800 Checkers voucher after validation, while voucher stock lasts.
terms: South African customers aged 18 or older must buy four qualifying Dunlop Grandtrek tyres during the campaign at a participating authorised Dunlop Branded Store and register the purchase for free 18-month Dunlop Sure tyre insurance at purchase or within seven days. Dunlop validates the purchase, registration and customer details before sending the R800 Checkers voucher to the participant's WhatsApp-enabled number, normally within 7 to 14 working days. A South African ID, vehicle and purchase details are required. The promotion runs from 12 August to 11 September 2026 but is first come, first served and can end earlier when the available vouchers are exhausted; purchase and successful validation do not guarantee a voucher after stock runs out.

title: Choose three free Clarins samples with an online order
summary: Clarins South Africa lets online shoppers choose up to three complimentary skincare or make-up samples at checkout with any paid order, subject to availability.
terms: A paid online order from the Clarins South Africa store is required. After shopping, open the bag at checkout and select up to three complimentary skincare or make-up samples from the available sample catalogue. Clarins says the catalogue can contain more than 120 sample-sized products and that each sample generally provides one to five uses. Selection is subject to availability, samples cannot be requested separately by post, and normal product prices, checkout and delivery conditions for the paid order still apply.

title: Free surprise Bellas sample with a paid online order
summary: Add Bellas' free-gift item to a paid online order to receive one surprise skincare, bath, hair or beauty sample, while stocks last.
terms: A paid Bellas online order is required, and the R0 surprise-gift item must be added to the cart before checkout. The offer is limited to one gift per paid order, online orders only and available stock. Bellas chooses the surprise sample according to availability; it may be a mini skincare, bath, hair or beauty product and arrives with the purchased order. The current offer page also displays an undated 'orders must be placed and paid before midnight' condition, so confirm it before paying. Bellas states that South African orders above R600 and qualifying promotional combo packs receive free delivery; otherwise a delivery charge is calculated at checkout. Product prices and delivery charges therefore still apply to the qualifying order.

title: Complimentary beauty samples with every online order
summary: Metropolitain Cosmetics includes complimentary beauty sample selections with every paid online order, chosen according to the shopper's interests and current availability.
terms: A paid online order from Metropolitain Cosmetics is required. During the order, shoppers are asked what type of samples they would like included, but Metropolitain selects the complimentary sample or samples according to the shopper's stated needs or interests and what is available at the time; no fixed quantity, brand or product is promised. Delivery is limited to South African street addresses and excludes PO boxes. The official delivery page states that orders below R700 carry a R150 shipping fee and orders over R700 receive free shipping, excluding weekends and public holidays.

title: R50 off selected Mr Price girls 7-14 denim shorts
summary: Mr Price lists R50 off selected girls 7-14 denim shorts online and in participating stores.
terms: The promotion applies only to selected girls 7-14 denim shorts shown on the official page and is advertised online and in store. Price, size, colour, store participation and stock can vary. No end date is stated, so confirm the discount before paying.

title: R50 off selected Mr Price boys 7-14 denim shorts
summary: Mr Price lists R50 off selected boys 7-14 denim shorts online and in participating stores.
terms: The promotion applies only to selected boys 7-14 denim shorts shown on the official page and is advertised online and in store. Price, size, colour, store participation and stock can vary. No end date is stated, so confirm the discount before paying.

title: R30 off selected Mr Price girls 1-7 denim shorts
summary: Mr Price lists R30 off selected girls 1-7 denim shorts online and in participating stores.
terms: The promotion applies only to selected girls 1-7 denim shorts shown on the official page and is advertised online and in store. Price, size, colour, store participation and stock can vary. No end date is stated, so confirm the discount before paying.

title: 10% off regular-price AKIS clothing in September
summary: Confirm your email to receive a personal 10% coupon for eligible regular-price clothing at AKIS. Sign into the account with the same email address to redeem it.
couponInstructions: Confirm your email on AKIS to receive your personal code.
terms: Valid 1–30 September 2026 until 23:59 SAST. Personal, non-transferable code issued after email confirmation; use an AKIS account with the same email. Reusable on eligible orders during September, with no minimum order or maximum monetary discount. Sale and promotional-price products, delivery and non-product charges are excluded. Cannot combine with another coupon. Freehub has verified the advertised terms, not redeemed the coupon.

title: Free day entry at Kruger, West Coast and Augrabies: 7–11 September
summary: South African citizens can visit these three national parks without a day-entry fee during their shorter SANParks Week window.
terms: 7–11 September 2026 only; the weekend is excluded. Bring South African identification, including valid identification for children. Park capacity and access conditions apply. Accommodation, guided activities, game drives and other paid activities remain chargeable. Transport and meals are not included. Confirm park-specific conditions before travelling.

title: Free day entry at participating national parks: 7–13 September
summary: Use SANParks Week for a day visit at participating parks including Addo Elephant, Garden Route, Golden Gate Highlands and Mokala.
terms: South African citizens must bring identification; children also need valid identification. Use the official park list: Kruger, West Coast and Augrabies end on 11 September. Namaqua, Boulders Penguin Colony and the Table Mountain Aerial Cableway are excluded. Accommodation and paid activities are excluded; transport and food still cost money. Admission remains subject to each park’s conditions and visitor limits.

title: CapeNature free walk-in day access: 19–25 September
summary: Participating Western Cape reserves waive general conservation entry fees for permitted day activities during Access Week. Walk-in access only.
terms: 19–25 September 2026 during normal reserve hours. No pre-booking for free entry; capacity limits apply. Online or Contact Centre bookings are charged. The waiver covers general conservation entry for permitted day activities, including hiking and mountain biking. Whale Trail, selected landowners, partners, concessions and commercial activities are excluded. Accommodation is not free. Check trail closures, opening hours and the official participating-reserve list.

title: Mugg & Bean new-app cappuccino after qualifying spend
summary: New Mugg & Bean app users who spend over R50 in their first month qualify for one complimentary Easy Cappuccino voucher.
terms: App registration and spending over R50 in the first month are required. One Easy Cappuccino voucher is issued to qualifying new users; no loyalty is earned when redeeming it. The public clause does not specify its redemption expiry, so check the voucher in the app before visiting. This welcome reward is separate from the birthday cake benefit.

title: Two selected Mr Price sleepwear separates for R130
summary: Buy two qualifying sleepwear separates for R130 at Mr Price, online or in store. Tops and shorts count as separate items; selected styles and stock only.
terms: Choose two eligible pieces from the official sleepwear promotion. A top and a pair of shorts are separate items, not two complete sleepwear sets. Mr Price advertises this offer online and in store for a limited time, with the discount applied at checkout. The selected-product page showed available listings when checked on 18 September 2026; sizes, colours and stock can change. No fixed end date is stated. Check that both chosen pieces qualify and that the combined promotional price appears before paying. Delivery charges and normal shopping conditions remain separate. FreeHub checked the merchant page but did not place an order or test checkout.

title: Two selected Mr Price essential tees for R120
summary: Buy two qualifying men’s essential tees for R120 at Mr Price, online or in store. The promotion applies only to selected products, with the discount at checkout.
terms: Choose two eligible men’s essential tees from the official selected-product page. This is a two-item purchase offer, not a R120 price for every T-shirt pair in the store. Mr Price advertises the promotion online and in store for a limited time and says the discount applies at checkout. The qualifying collection contained product listings when checked on 18 September 2026; individual product prices can appear higher before the multibuy is applied. Sizes, colours and stock vary. No fixed end date is stated. Confirm that both items qualify and that the combined promotional price appears before paying. Delivery charges are separate. FreeHub did not place an order or test checkout.

title: ASUS Cash Dash 2026: cashback on eligible tech
summary: Buy an eligible ASUS product from a listed South African dealer by 28 September 2026 and claim the model-specific cashback through ASUS by 12 October. R12,912 is the combined maximum across one item from each product line, not the cashback on a single item.
terms: Qualifying product purchase period: 18 August–28 September 2026; redemption: 1 September–12 October 2026, CET. South African resident, participating dealer, listed model and part number, matching purchase invoice and ASUS VIP registration required. Claim through the official ASUS campaign page, which currently routes to an ASUS login. Cashback varies by product; the advertised R12,912 is an aggregate maximum across categories. The terms introduction mistakenly says Q3 2025, while its title, detailed dates and campaign page say 2026. After 28 September, only people who already made a qualifying purchase can still submit a claim.

title: Free 1 GB for first login to the new MTN App
summary: Eligible MTN customers logging into the new MTN App for the first time can claim a free 1 GB bundle from My Gifts within 24 hours of notification; the redeemed data lasts 24 hours.
terms: New MTN App, MTN customer and successful first authenticated login required; MTN decides eligibility using its records, mobile number and/or device. Check the My Gifts menu and claim within 24 hours of being notified. The 1 GB bundle expires 24 hours after redemption. The promotion is listed through 31 December 2026 but may change or be withdrawn. Download or network data costs may apply, though MTN says the app can be used without data once downloaded. No purchase is stated in these terms.

title: AMC cookware gifts with qualifying purchases
summary: Qualifying AMC cookware orders can receive a 16cm Milk Boiler or Gourmet High at R11,360 spend, or a 30cm Gourmet Roaster at R19,300. Purchase required.
terms: Offer runs 8 September–7 October 2026. Gift depends on qualifying spend and order type. Credit-order gifts are delivered after full payment within the contract period. PriceSaver, Stokvel and interest-free orders require an AMC Consultant; these order types are not available online. Confirm the selected gift and order total with AMC before paying. Cook’s Book thresholds are omitted because wording differs at the exact spend boundary.

title: CeraVe SA Smoothing Cream gift with R999 CeraVe spend
summary: SkinStore advertises a CeraVe SA Smoothing Cream 177ml gift with R999 spent on CeraVe products. Qualifying purchase required; confirm availability before checkout.
terms: The qualifying spend is on CeraVe products, not the whole cart. The official homepage advertises the 177ml gift; no expiry date or live stock level is stated. Confirm the current offer, gift inclusion and any delivery charges with SkinStore before payment. No specific extra qualifying conditions were verified.

title: SkinStore skincare samples with paid orders
summary: SkinStore advertises complimentary skincare samples with orders. A paid order is required; sample products vary with availability.
terms: This is a purchase-linked benefit, not an unconditional freebie. Exact sample brands, contents and quantities are not guaranteed. The provider does not state an expiry date or current stock level. Confirm samples and any order/delivery charges before checkout.

title: Sebamed samples with paid online orders
summary: The official Sebamed South Africa shop advertises free samples with all orders. A paid order is required; sample contents are not specified.
terms: Purchase required. The homepage banner currently advertises samples with all orders; it does not specify contents, quantities, expiry or live inventory. Confirm availability and delivery charges with the provider before paying. The artwork shows the product range, not a promised sample pack.

title: R199 onsite admission for African citizens
summary: African citizens can buy a R199 museum admission ticket in person with identification. This is a paid admission discount.
terms: Present a South African ID or African passport and buy onsite at Zeitz MOCAA, V&A Waterfront, Cape Town. The advertised rate took effect on 1 September 2026. It is not the online general-admission rate; no closing date is stated. Check the existing free Wednesday and birthday routes before paying.

title: Table Mountain October adult return ticket for R265
summary: The October Local is Lekker special advertises an adult return ticket for R265 for qualifying South African visitors.
terms: Valid 1–31 October 2026. Buy online through the booking link on the official specials page before the day of your visit and bring your South African ID. Paid ticket; this is not free admission. Check final booking charges and operating/weather conditions before paying. This listing covers the adult ticket only; check child-ticket ages and booking fees separately.

title: 10% Exclusive Books cashback on the 10th of the month
summary: Capitec Live Better members can earn 10% cashback on eligible Exclusive Books purchases made on the 10th.
terms: Join Live Better through the Capitec app, then shop at Exclusive Books in-store or online on the 10th of the month and pay with a Capitec debit, credit or virtual card. Cashback is paid into Live Better savings on the following monthly Live Better day. Cannot be combined with Fanatics Rewards. This requires a paid purchase and an eligible bank account; underlying account fees are separate. No campaign end date is published.

title: 50% off eligible Nu Metro tickets with Absa Rewards
summary: Qualifying Absa Rewards members can receive an upfront half-price ticket discount within their annual allocation.
terms: Book at the Nu Metro website or participating kiosk, choose Absa Rewards, enter the requested ID details and pay with your eligible Absa card. Annual allocation: 12 standard 2D/3D tickets, 2 VIP tickets and 2 Xtreme tickets. Standard tickets exclude full-VIP Bedford, Hyde Park, Mountain Mill and Woodlands cinemas. VIP: Cornubia, Ballito, Canal Walk, The Glen, The Pavilion, Clearwater, Bedford, Hyde Park, Woodlands, Galleria, Emperors Palace and Menlyn Park. Xtreme: Cornubia, Ballito, Canal Walk, The Glen, Clearwater, Galleria, Emperors Palace and Menlyn Park. Excludes 4DX, alternative/live-event screenings and combining benefits; unused allocations do not carry over. Paid ticket and qualifying bank-account conditions apply.

title: Cotton On Perks R75 voucher after R750 eligible spend
summary: Earn a R75 shopping voucher after R750 cumulative qualifying spend, then meet the separate redemption minimum.
terms: Use your South African Cotton On & Co. Perks membership when buying eligible full-price goods in-store or online. Sale goods, gift cards and donations do not earn points. Online points post after dispatch. Each R75 voucher requires at least R200 spend to redeem; two require R400. Check the expiry printed on each issued voucher. This is a reward for paid shopping, not R75 cash or an unconditional free purchase. Delivery thresholds are assessed after discounts.

title: R400 off a first qualifying Superbalist order of R1,000
summary: New customers can apply FIRSTBUY to an eligible first order of at least R1,000. Delivery may cost extra.
terms: First-time customers only, once per customer and one promotion per checkout. Sale and non-shippable products are excluded. A qualifying R1,000 basket becomes R600 before delivery. Check the actual delivery charge after discounts; this listing does not promise free delivery. No fixed campaign closing date is stated.

title: RocoMamas welcome Cheese Bombs voucher with R150 spend
summary: New Roco App members can receive a voucher for 3 Cheese Bombs, subject to at least R150 spend.
terms: Download and register through the Roco App; the voucher loads after successful registration and is valid for 3 months. Redeem using the app identification/OTP process with a R150 or larger qualifying bill. Personal and non-transferable; eligible South African restaurants support on-premises, call-and-collect and Click & Collect. Adult/guardian and staff-exclusion terms apply. This is a gift with paid dining, not a standalone free meal.
couponInstructions: Register in the Roco App and redeem the personal welcome voucher using the app/OTP process.

title: Col’Cacchio kids meal with a qualifying adult main
summary: Selected branches offer one Bambini meal for a child aged 12 or under with one qualifying full-price adult main.
terms: One child meal per full-priced standard adult main; Piccolo and discounted adult mains are excluded. Stock and participating-branch restrictions apply; do not combine with other promotions. Verified windows: Blouberg, Durbanville, Paardevlei, The Grove and Willowbridge Monday–Friday until 18:00; Canal Walk Monday–Sunday 16:00–19:00; Belvedere, Meadowridge and Stellenbosch all day daily. Haasendal is excluded because the official page lists conflicting windows. The adult meal must be purchased.

title: Clicks BabyClub 4% cashback on most baby products
summary: Eligible BabyClub members earn 4% ClubCard cashback on most baby products, excluding legislated products.
terms: Join Clicks BabyClub using your ClubCard membership. The official eligibility is expectant mothers, parents or guardians with children under 36 months. Earn on eligible paid purchases; the benefit is ClubCard cashback under the programme rules, not free products or guaranteed cash withdrawal. Legislated products are excluded. Check the eligible item and current ClubCard redemption rules before shopping.

title: Clicks Seniors Club: double points on qualifying Wednesdays
summary: Eligible Seniors Club members can earn double base ClubCard points on qualifying Wednesday shopping.
terms: Age 60+ with date of birth or ID recorded for Seniors Club enrolment. Free ClubCard membership and qualifying purchases are required. Scan the card before payment; exclusions apply to regulated goods and amounts paid with cashback. Points convert to redeemable ClubCard rewards under the programme’s thresholds and expiry rules, rather than cash. The official pages use inconsistent percentage wording, so no flat cashback percentage is promised here.

title: Dermastore DermaPoints towards a later purchase
summary: Registered members can earn points described by Dermastore as roughly 5% of the previous order total.
terms: Shop while signed into a registered Dermastore account; guest checkout does not earn points. Points can only be redeemed after the first completed purchase. The published conversion is 100 points for R10 discount; maximum redemption is 5,000 points/R500 per order. Points expire 12 months after earning. Certain promotions do not earn points; use the amount shown for the selected product. This requires paid purchases and is not a guaranteed exact 5% return on every item.

title: MTN monthly 1GB data for eligible ayoba activity
summary: MTN terms offer 1GB monthly for eligible activity inside ayoba, capped at 250MB per day.
terms: For MTN subscribers using ayoba. The monthly allocation is made on the 1st and unused data is forfeited by the last calendar day; no transfer or sharing. Eligible activities include ayoba chat, media and channels; the terms separately limit ayoba-browser browsing to 00:00–04:59. It is not general-purpose 1GB data. Voice/video over IP can be excluded, and external or otherwise ineligible activity can incur normal data charges. Do not promise free calls or unrestricted browsing.

title: Table Mountain South African senior return ticket for R130
summary: Qualifying South African senior visitors can buy an onsite return ticket for R130.
terms: The published rate is valid 1 July 2026–30 June 2027. Buy at the ticket office and bring a South African ID; the rate table specifies 60+ even though adjacent prose says over 60. Check eligibility at the office if exactly 60. This is paid admission; the senior special is not sold online. Operating and weather conditions apply.

title: 1% Cashbuild cashback for Capitec Rewards members
summary: Eligible Capitec card purchases at Cashbuild can earn 1% cashback.
terms: Join Capitec Rewards in the app or at a branch and pay at Cashbuild in-store or online with a Capitec debit, credit or virtual card. Cashback goes to Live Better savings on the following monthly Live Better day. Requires an eligible bank account and a paid purchase; account fees are separate. No fixed benefit end date is published.

title: 2.5% Tiger Wheel & Tyre cashback with Capitec
summary: Eligible Capitec Rewards purchases can earn 2.5% cashback, capped at R125 per transaction per day.
terms: Join Capitec Rewards and pay at participating Tiger Wheel & Tyre stores using an eligible Capitec card. The official cap is R125 per transaction per day; do not advertise unlimited 2.5% back. Cashback is paid into Live Better savings on the following monthly Live Better day. Paid goods/services and underlying bank-account fees are separate. Check current partner eligibility before paying.

title: Ster-Kinekor SK Club half-price Tuesdays
summary: SK Club members can receive a 50% ticket discount on Tuesdays under the club rules.
terms: Register for SK Club and use your membership number when booking a qualifying Tuesday ticket. The definition limits the benefit to one ticket for each unique show time; the reward section also says members may not watch the same movie more than once with the membership number. Published formats include 2D, 3D, IMAX, Cine Prestige, APEX and Kids’ Cinema. Availability and film age restrictions apply; 3D glasses are extra. Do not combine with The Epic Deal or other incompatible promotions. Adult identity or guardian-consent membership rules apply; the ticket remains paid.

title: Ster-Kinekor Seniors 20% ticket saving
summary: SK Seniors Club members aged 60 and over can receive 20% off tickets on days other than Tuesday.
terms: Use an eligible SK Seniors Club membership number when booking. Tuesdays use the separate half-price benefit instead of an extra stacked 20% discount. Seniors membership does not earn the ordinary SK Club points; existing points must be redeemed 7 days before switching or are forfeited. Paid tickets, seat availability, screening age restrictions and extra 3D-glasses charges apply.

title: Ster-Kinekor weekday Epic Deal for R169.90
summary: SK Club offers a paid bundle of one 2D/3D ticket, regular popcorn and a regular drink for R169.90.
terms: For SK Club members, Monday–Friday only. Drink choices are regular soda, water or Slush. Excludes IMAX, Cine Prestige, APEX and D-Box; 3D glasses are extra. Cannot be combined with half-price Tuesday. Membership, seat availability and screening age restrictions apply. This is an advertised bundle offer, not a free cinema ticket; no independently verified savings percentage is claimed.

terms: The three primary offers run in store throughout November, one per purchase. Online: 1–10 November gives 20% off products in designated fabrics. 11–20 November offers one eligible ottoman with R15,000 or more of qualifying products, excluding delivery. 21–30 November offers tiered savings on qualifying full-price merchandise. Express Shipping items and partner offers are excluded from these primary offers. Check the official list of fabrics, collections and spend tiers. Discounts do not stack.

summary: The official Black November terms advertise 10%, 20% and 30% discounts at three qualifying spend levels.
terms: Spend at least R1,000 for 10% off, R2,500 for 20% or R5,000 for 30% during 1–30 November. The highest qualifying tier applies, and shipping does not count towards the threshold. Discounts cannot be combined. The terms do not list a public code. Confirm the eligible basket and discount before paying.

title: iHerb NEW20 First Order Discount
summary: New iHerb customers in South Africa can use NEW20 for 20% off their first order before shipping and taxes.
terms: For new customers only. Apply NEW20 at checkout on the website or app. It is single use and the discount is calculated before shipping and taxes. iHerb's South African shipping policy says import duties, taxes or handling fees can apply, depending on the order and carrier. Check the final cost before paying. The official code terms give no fixed expiry date.

title: Free Rustenburg Film Festival Admission
summary: Register for free admission to the Rustenburg Film Festival's 10th anniversary programme in Cashan, Rustenburg.
terms: The organiser lists 5–8 November 2026 at Upper East Side, 1 Abbey Street, Cashan. Admission is free with registration through the official ticket page, subject to availability. The ticket widget displays an end time of midnight at the start of 8 November. Check the schedule and ticket status before travelling.

title: Free Ngeke! Festival Ticket in Johannesburg
summary: Sign the organiser's anti-corruption pledge and choose the free festival ticket option for 7 November at The Nest in Johannesburg.
terms: The festival takes place on 7 November 2026 at The Nest, 39 Voorhout Street, New Doornfontein, Johannesburg. Sign the pledge and select the option that also reserves a free ticket. The pledge-only option does not reserve admission. Check current availability and event details with the organiser.

terms: The venue advertises free entry for everyone from 14:30 to 20:30 on Saturday, 7 November 2026, at Yellow Sands on the East Coast Resorts road near East London. Food and market purchases are separate.

terms: The organiser confirms Saturday, 28 November 2026 and free admission. Use the organiser's current event information to plan the visit. The downloadable 2025 guide describes the previous edition.

summary: Eligible Absa Rewards members can earn an extra 10% on their first R1,500 of qualifying fuel spend, capped at R150 extra.

Buy fuel exclusively at Sasol or Shell in the campaign month, using an eligible digital wallet or virtual Absa card. Shell V+ requirements apply. Fuel purchases and account fees remain payable; this is conditional cashback, not free fuel. Read the full terms before changing your usual fuel purchases.

Bring ID or pension proof. Camping relief covers one site’s base tariff and qualifying persons; additional guests may pay full tariffs. Conservation fees and meals remain payable. Accommodation discounts depend on the exact camp and unit in the 2026 matrix.

The extra 25c is credited on the first of the next month after the spend threshold is met. Paid Xtra Savings Plus members earn 50c from the first qualifying litre. Xcash lasts 12 months and is usable at eligible group stores or Sixty60, not for fuel or cash; fleet purchases and specified services are excluded.

Cancel at least one day before renewal; cancelling during the free period ends access immediately.

Direct-store takeaways qualify, third-party delivery does not.

A paid dozen is required; prices vary by your chosen dozen.

summary: Eligible first-time Premium users can try Standard for one month, then pay R69.99 a month unless they cancel.

The offer is the monthly Standard trial, not a prepaid wallet option or an expired multi-month promotion. Confirm the first billing date and cancel through your account before renewal to avoid the next charge.

title: Builders: 10% off qualifying in-store Wednesday purchases for over-60s
summary: Eligible Builders cardholders older than 60 can receive a 10% Wednesday discount on qualifying in-store purchases.
terms: Present your Builders card and age identification to the cashier in-store on Wednesday. Personal purchases only; no promotion stacking or later claim after forgetting the card. Excludes discounted or below-cost products, services, direct-to-site and special orders. Major exclusions include appliances, air conditioning, cables, building aggregates, copper fittings, generators, gas, window frames, geysers, tanks, doors, boards and ladders, plus Plascon, Dulux, Duram and HTH. The official terms use “over 60”; customers exactly 60 should confirm qualification. Online eligibility is contradictory: clause 20.9 excludes website-generated sales, while clause 36.2.1 mentions online checkout. This page confirms the in-store benefit only. Check with Builders before relying on a pensioner discount for any online purchase.

title: Makro mSenior: savings on eligible food and general merchandise
summary: Registered shoppers aged 60+ can receive a product-dependent mSenior discount in-store and online.
terms: Requires a valid mSenior Citizens Card/profile and South African ID or passport. Current October 2026 terms allow at most 5% on selected food and 10% on selected general merchandise, subject to Makro’s approved cost floor; these are not guaranteed flat reductions. Personal purchases only. Excludes promotions, Marketplace sellers, delivery, liquor, tobacco, cellular, gift/prepaid and financial products, LPG, motor oil, pool chemicals, copier paper and baby formula.

title: Vodacom RED: eligible Amazon Prime trials of three or twelve months
summary: Qualifying RED Flexi customers can receive three months of Prime; RED Core customers can receive twelve. Thereafter, it costs R59 monthly unless cancelled.
terms: A qualifying paid consumer contract is required. Be active on Vodacom for at least 30 days and have had no trial benefit in the previous 12 months. Business/corporate contracts do not qualify. Activate the offer shown through Vodacom’s website, VodaPay or an official invitation and link your Amazon account. Contract and data charges remain payable. This is the Amazon Prime benefit, distinct from older Prime Video Mobile Edition offers.
